title: App descriptor apps/<app>.yaml (schema 1)
description: Declares only what the platform creates or fences for one app (design/platform-design.md ADR-IR34, section 7.0). Shape (languages, build steps, services) stays in the app's own files under codefresh/apps/<app>/, .octopus/apps/<app>/, gitops/apps/<app>/ and containers/apps/<app>/. Consumers: the tenant chart (gitops/platform/tenant), octopus/terraform (for_each over apps/*.yaml), terraform/apps/tier, terraform/apps/grants, codefresh/register.sh --app and tools/Platform.Onboarding. Rules a schema cannot express (the file name equals `name`, uniqueness across descriptors, deployables naming declared projects, the reserved `sandbox`) are enforced by `Platform.Onboarding check`. Defaults below are the values every consumer applies when a key is absent.

name.description: The app slug (ADR-IR34 decision 10): 3 to 12 characters, no dash. Every per-app name derives from it: namespaces <app>-<env> and <app>-<part>-<env>, AppProject app-<app>, Octopus group app-<app>, registry paths apps/<app>/<image>, vault kv-<app>-<e>-<hash4>, disk disk-<app>-<env>-db. Reserved words are refused; `sandbox` is accepted by the schema for the conformance fixture only, and `Platform.Onboarding new` refuses it.

description.description: One line for `Platform.Onboarding list` and the docs.

status.description: active: everything is rendered. frozen (ADR-IR34 decision 28): the tenant keeps namespaces, stores and disks, and sets workloads and the database to zero replicas; octopus/terraform disables the app's projects; codefresh/register.sh --app turns the triggers off. Retirement deletes the descriptor (Platform.Onboarding retire).

expires.description: Optional end of the course. `Platform.Onboarding check` warns within 14 days of it and after it; it never fails on it.

repositories.description: The app's source repositories, all in the org clearmeasure-aisf-sample-apps (the only org the Git integration github-aisf-sample-apps reaches). The first entry is the primary repository: scaffolded pipeline triggers and the end-to-end pass use it. App repositories receive no platform file (ADR-D18).

environments.description: Application environments this app runs in. The tier map is fixed: tdd and uat on nonprod, prod on prod; descriptors cannot change it.

codefresh.description: Codefresh projects of the app. Pipelines are the app's own: YAML at codefresh/apps/<app>/pipelines/, specs at codefresh/apps/<app>/specs/ (ADR-IR34 decision 19). Release pipelines are named release or release-<x> (the prod signer rule).

octopus.description: Octopus objects of the app. octopus/terraform creates project group app-<app>, one project shell per entry (config as code at .octopus/apps/<app>/<project>/), its channels, the prod freeze scope and the optional accounts.

projects.description: 1 to 20 projects (ADR-IR34 decision 14: one federated credential per project on the deploy identity).

azureAccount.description: true: terraform/apps/grants creates id-<app>-<env>-deploy per environment (Key Vault Secrets User on the app vault; Contributor on rg-app-<app>-<tier> when azure.resourceGroup is true) with one federated credential per Octopus project, and octopus/terraform creates the OIDC account azure-<app>-<env>.

deployables.description: Argo CD Applications <app>-<deployable>-<env>, rendered by the tenant chart at gitops/apps/<app>/envs/<env>/<deployable>/ with the Octopus annotations. The database is not listed here: it is the reserved deployable db (key `database`).

database.description: Optional database in a pod per environment. The tenant chart renders Application <app>-db-<env> (label platform/role: database, no Octopus annotations) from gitops/apps/<app>/envs/<env>/db/, a ClusterSecretStore <app>-<env>, the static PersistentVolume of disk-<app>-<env>-db, and the backup CronJob (uat, prod) plus the suspended restore CronJob in platform-backup. terraform/apps/tier creates the disk and generates the SQL login passwords (sa, <app>_migrator, <app>_app) into the app vault. The database name is <app>.

octopusWorkerAccess.description: true: the NetworkPolicy also admits database traffic from octopus-worker-<env> (app steps on the shared k8s-<env> pool, such as acceptance tests that seed the database).

azure.description: Optional Azure access beyond the platform. Security owners review every descriptor that sets any of these keys (CODEOWNERS).

resourceGroup.description: true: terraform/apps/grants creates rg-app-<app>-<tier> for app-owned Azure services.

workloadIdentity.description: true: terraform/apps/grants creates id-<app>-<env>-app, and terraform/apps/tier its federated credential system:serviceaccount:<app>-<env>:<serviceAccount> and the vault key azure-client-id (ADR-IR34 decision 11; ESO maps it to AZURE_CLIENT_ID).

serviceAccount.description: Kubernetes service account of the app's pods in <app>-<env>; required with workloadIdentity.

roles.description: Roles of id-<app>-<env>-app on rg-app-<app>-<tier>, from the allowed list; require resourceGroup and workloadIdentity.

quotas.description: Optional per-namespace quota. Descriptors may only lower the platform default: 4 GiB memory, 2 CPU, 3 PVCs, 50 GiB storage; LoadBalancer and NodePort Services are always 0.

previews.description: Phase 6 (ADR-C4): true renders AppProject app-<app>-previews on nonprod; images go to apps-previews/<app>/<image>.

secrets.description: App-specific keys in the app vault kv-<app>-<e>-<hash4>, besides the platform keys (db-sa-password, db-migrator-password, db-app-password, appinsights-connection-string, azure-client-id). terraform/apps/tier creates each key once: a random value when generate is true, otherwise a stand-in value that a member of platform-operators replaces. The app's own ExternalSecrets read them through store <app>-<env>.

projectName.description: <app> or <app>-<part>; the tool checks that the prefix is the descriptor's name.

imageName.description: Repository name under apps/<app>/ in <acr-name>, also the Octopus package ID apps/<app>/<image> in feed acr-apps.

name.description: owner/name in clearmeasure-aisf-sample-apps, or a section 7.0 placeholder such as <sandbox-app-repo>.

lifecycle.description: Lifecycle of channel Default and of every channel except Hotfix, which always uses platform-hotfix.

channels.description: Channel names. Must include Default. The sandbox adds Strict, whose channel-scoped Platform.SoDMode is enforce.

name.description: Deployable name; db is reserved for the database.

part.description: Optional part: the deployable then runs in namespace <app>-<part>-<env> with host <app>-<part>-<env>.<apps-domain-<tier>>. Without it: <app>-<env>. db and pr are reserved.

octopusProject.description: Octopus project that pins this deployable: the value of argo.octopus.com/project. Must be one of octopus.projects[].name.

packaging.description: kustomize: pin images[].newTag in envs/<env>/<deployable>/kustomization.yaml. helm: pin the values at helm.imageReplacePaths in envs/<env>/<deployable>/values.yaml. raw: pin the image: fields of the manifests in envs/<env>/<deployable>/.

images.description: Images this deployable pins, as names under apps/<app>/.

helm.description: Required when packaging is helm, forbidden otherwise. The chart is vendored in Git (ADR-IR34 decision 7).

imageReplacePaths.description: Value of the annotation argo.octopus.com/image-replace-paths, one entry per image, for example {{ .Values.image.repository }}:{{ .Values.image.tag }}.

name.description: Key Vault secret name; the platform keys and the db- prefix are reserved.
